about: Esquimalt is a district municipality west of Victoria on Vancouver Island, wrapped around Esquimalt Harbour and CFB Esquimalt, Canada’s Pacific naval base. Working waterfront, older neighbourhoods, and harbour views sit next to the capital without being part of the City of Victoria. About 17,000 people live in Esquimalt.
